project.purpose: Own durable external-continuity Tasks, checkpoints, Board collaboration, and exact re-entry navigation without becoming a scheduler, priority authority, Runtime proxy, or domain truth owner.

nodes.label: TaskContinuity
nodes.responsibility: Persist exact Host Task revisions and semantic working checkpoints for external continuity.
acceptance: Exact task.resume can re-enter one revision-fenced continuity point.

nodes.label: Board
nodes.responsibility: Persist collaboration records and deterministic Task route anchors without creating priority or ownership.
acceptance: Board messages remain collaboration records only.

nodes.label: AttentionDelta
nodes.responsibility: Project bounded Board-sequence deltas into exact Task re-entry navigation.
acceptance: Delta consumer must still resume exact Task before acting.

nodes.label: PostgresJournal
nodes.responsibility: Own Host durable object/revision storage using PostgreSQL and canonical JSON semantics.
acceptance: Restart preserves Host revision identity and task/board continuity.

Host PostgreSQL authority is source-qualified by the existing Repo SQL dialect gate: active Host service/migration Python sources may not import SQLite engines or define SQLite DSNs; the native negative controls reject a second embedded engine. This says nothing about Runtime/Harness local recovery stores, and does not claim a completed data cutover.

edges.label: route delta to exact task revision
